boss.name: Grammar Phantom 'Mr. Comparative'
boss.introText: If you confuse personality with appearance or write 'gooder than', you will never defeat me!
boss.defeatText: Awesome! You mastered adjectives and comparative rules like a native speaker!

lessons.title: 👤 Physical Appearance vs Personality Adjectives
lessons.summary: Dış görünüş ve kişilik sıfatlarını ayırt etme kuralı.
points: Physical Appearance (Dış Görünüş): Gözle görülebilen özellikler: tall (uzun), short (kısa), slim (zayıf/ince), plump (tombul), wavy hair (dalgalı saç), straight hair (düz saç), blue eyes, brown eyes, attractive, well-built (kaslı).

Personality (Kişilik / Karakter Sıfatları):
• Honest (Dürüst): Always tells the truth, never tells lies (Richard & Sally).
• Friendly / Outgoing (Sosyal / Cana yakın): Likes meeting new people, has lots of friends (Sue & Harry).
• Selfish (Bencil): Only cares about himself/herself, doesn't like sharing toys (Dean & Amy).
• Successful / Hardworking (Başarılı / Çalışkan): Studies hard, always does homework, gets high marks (Frank & Gloria).
• Punctual (Dakik): Always on time, never late (Tom).
• Generous (Cömert): Likes sharing and helping others (Mary).

Soru Kalıpları:
• 'What does he look like?' ➔ Dış görünüşü sorar.
• 'What is she like?' ➔ Kişilik ve karakterini sorar!
lessons.examTip: Sınavda Sorulur: 'What is he like?' sorusuna 'He has brown hair' YAZILMAZ! Bu soru kişiliği sorar, 'He is generous and honest' denir!

quickCheck.q: Aşağıdaki sıfatlardan hangisi bir kişinin 'Personality' (kişilik) özelliğini belirtir?
quickCheck.explanation: Stubborn (inatçı) bir karakter/kişilik sıfatıdır. Diğerleri dış görünüştür.

pointAnalogies.title: Fotoğrafta Gördüğün Her Şey (Appearance)
pointAnalogies.text: Birinin fotoğrafına bakıp söyleyebileceğin özellikler (tall, slim, wavy hair, blue eyes) Physical Appearance'tır.

pointAnalogies.title: Tanıdıkça Gördüğün İç Dünya (Personality)
pointAnalogies.text: Fotoğrafta görünmez; konuşup arkadaş oldukça anlarsın: honest (dürüst), punctual (dakik), generous (cömert), selfish (bencil).

pointAnalogies.title: 'Look' Varsa Gözle Bak, Yoksa Kalbe Bak!
pointAnalogies.text: 'What does he LOOK like?' içinde LOOK (bakmak) olduğu için dış görünüşü sorar! 'What is she like?' ise karakterini sorar.

lessons.title: 📈 Making Comparisons (Karşılaştırma Cümleleri)
lessons.summary: İki insanı veya nesneyi birbiriyle kıyaslama kuralları.
points:
Kısa Sıfatlar (1-2 hece): Sıfatın sonuna -er ve ardından than gelir:
fast ➔ faster than, tall ➔ taller than, easy ➔ easier than.

Uzun Sıfatlar (3+ hece): Sıfatın başına more gelir:
more generous than, more hardworking than, more outgoing than.

Düzensizler (Irregular):
• good ➔ better than (asla gooder denmez!)
• bad ➔ worse than
• far ➔ further / farther than
lessons.examTip: Sınavda Sorulur: 'Gooder than' diye bir kural YOKTUR! 'Good' sıfatı 'better than', 'bad' sıfatı 'worse than' olur!

quickCheck.q: 'Ali is ___________ than Mehmet.' cümlesinde 'hardworking' sıfatı nasıl kullanılmalıdır?
quickCheck.explanation: Hardworking uzun bir sıfat olduğu için karşılaştırmada 'more hardworking' şeklinde kullanılır.

pointAnalogies.title: Kısa Kelimeye Turbo Kuyruk: -er + than
pointAnalogies.text: Tek-iki heceli kısa sıfatlar sonuna '-er' kuyruğu takar: tall → taller than, fast → faster than.

pointAnalogies.title: Uzun Kelimeyi Baştan Çeken Lokomotif: MORE
pointAnalogies.text: Zaten uzun olan kelimenin sonuna ek koyma, başına 'more' getir: more hardworking than, more generous than.

pointAnalogies.title: Kural Tanımayan 3 Asi Kelime
pointAnalogies.text: Asla 'gooder' veya 'badder' deme! good → better, bad → worse, far → further/farther olur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Punctual' means always coming on time (her zaman vaktinde gelen).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Punctual dakik anlamına gelir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'What is she like?' question asks about physical hair color.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! 'What is she like?' karakterini ve kişiliğini sorar.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The comparative form of 'good' is 'better than'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Good düzensiz bir sıfattır ve better'a dönüşür.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: A 'clumsy' person breaks things easily because of carelessness.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Clumsy sakar demektir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Comparative of 'generous' is 'generouser'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Uzun sıfatlarda 'more generous' kullanılır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Selfish' people only think about themselves.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Selfish bencil demektir, sadece kendini düşünür.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Stubborn' means not changing your mind easily (inatçı).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Stubborn laf dinlemeyen, inatçı anlamına gelir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Honest' people never tell lies and always tell the truth.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Dürüst insanlar daima doğruyu söyler.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'What does he look like?' question asks about physical appearance (dış görünüş).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Boy, kilo, göz ve saç gibi dış özellikleri sorar.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The comparative form of 'easy' is 'more easy'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Son iki harfi sessiz+y olduğu için 'easier' olur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: An 'outgoing' person is very shy and avoids meeting new people.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Outgoing canayakın, sosyal ve dışa dönük demektir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Slim' and 'well-built' describe a person's physical appearance.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Zayıf ve kaslı/yapılı fiziksel tanımlardır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Talkative' people talk a lot and love chatting.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Konuşkan kimseler için kullanılır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The comparative form of 'bad' is 'bader'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! 'Bad' düzensiz sıfattır ve 'worse than' olur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Generous' people love sharing and buying presents for their friends.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Cömert kimseler paylaşmayı sever.

flashcards.q: 'What does he look like?' neyi sorar?
flashcards.a: Dış görünüşünü (Boy, kilo, saç, göz rengi)
Randevularına ve derslerine asla geç kalmaz (Dakik)

quizQuestions.q: Ayşe never arrives late to school and does everything on time. She is _________.
quizQuestions.explanation: Asla geç kalmayan ve zamanında yapan kişiye 'punctual' (dakik) denir.

quizQuestions.q: This book is ___________ than that movie.
quizQuestions.explanation: Uzun sıfatların karşılaştırmasında başına 'more' eklenir: more interesting than.

quizQuestions.q: Jack is very ____________. He only thinks about himself and never shares his toys.
quizQuestions.explanation: Sadece kendini düşünen ve paylaşmayan kişiye 'selfish' (bencil) denir.

quizQuestions.q: 'What does your English teacher look like?' sorusuna verilecek en uygun yanıt hangisidir?
options: She is tall and has blonde hair.
quizQuestions.explanation: 'What does she look like?' dış görünüşü sorar: She is tall and has blonde hair.

quizQuestions.q: My brother gets higher grades than me. He is ___________ student than me.

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.1.R1. Understand simple text about appearances, personalities, and comparisons.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Look at the grid below and write down the correct person / number for each question:

1. Frank always does his homework and gets high marks.
2. Sally never tells lies, so you can count on her.
3. Mary helps others when they have a problem.
4. Tom is always on time. He is never late.
5. Gloria studies hard, and she is the first in the class.
6. Sue likes meeting new people.
7. Harry has lots of friends and enjoys spending time with them.
8. Dean doesn’t like sharing his toys, and he cares about only himself.
9. Richard always tells the truth, so he is reliable.

a. Who is honest?
b. Who is friendly?
c. Who is selfish?
d. Who is successful?
e. Who is punctual?
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Answers:
a. Who is honest? ➔ Sally (2) and Richard (9) (They never tell lies and always tell the truth).
b. Who is friendly? ➔ Sue (6) and Harry (7) (or Mary - 3) (They like meeting new people and spending time with friends).
c. Who is selfish? ➔ Dean (8) (He doesn't share toys and only cares about himself).
d. Who is successful? ➔ Frank (1) and Gloria (5) (They get high marks and study hard).
e. Who is punctual? ➔ Tom (4) (He is always on time and never late).

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: Sally / Richard (honest) doğru yazılmış
b şıkkı: Sue / Harry (friendly) doğru yazılmış
c şıkkı: Dean (selfish) doğru yazılmış
d şıkkı: Frank / Gloria (successful) doğru yazılmış
e şıkkı: Tom (punctual) doğru yazılmış

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.1.R1. Understand simple text about appearances, personalities, and comparisons.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Read the text below, correct the mistakes, and rewrite the sentences:

"Amy is 10 years old, and Emily, her sister, is 12 years old. Amy is 1.55 m, and Emily is 1.62 m. Amy has long, wavy hair, and blue eyes. Emily has short, straight hair, and brown eyes. Amy is so energetic and enjoys spending time with her friends, but Emily is relaxed and prefers staying at home to play video games or read stories. Amy usually cares about only herself, but Emily cares about other people’s feelings. They have different personalities and styles, but they are good friends and enjoy playing games together."

a. Emily is younger than Amy.
b. Emily is more outgoing than Amy.
c. Amy is kinder than Emily.
d. Amy is taller than Emily.
e. Amy and Emily can’t get on well with each other.
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Corrected Sentences:
a. Emily is older than Amy. (or: Amy is younger than Emily.)
b. Amy is more outgoing than Emily. (or: Emily is less outgoing than Amy / prefers staying at home.)
c. Emily is kinder than Amy. (or: Amy is more selfish than Emily.)
d. Emily is taller than Amy. (or: Amy is shorter than Emily.)
e. Amy and Emily get on well with each other. (They are good friends and enjoy playing games together).

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: Yaş karşılaştırması düzeltilmiş (Emily is older than Amy)
b şıkkı: Sosyallik karşılaştırması düzeltilmiş (Amy is more outgoing than Emily)
c şıkkı: Karakter/bencillik düzeltilmiş (Emily is kinder than Amy)
d şıkkı: Boy karşılaştırması düzeltilmiş (Emily is taller than Amy)
e şıkkı: İlişki düzeltilmiş (Amy and Emily get on well with each other)

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.1.W1. Students will be able to write simple pieces to compare people.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Compare two Turkish paralympic swimmers by age, height, and weight. Complete the statements with the comparative forms of the correct adjectives:

• Sümeyye BOYACI: Age: 21 | Height: 1.58 m | Weight: 49 kg
• Sevilay ÖZTÜRK: Age: 20 | Height: 1.45 m | Weight: 34 kg

a. Sevilay is ___________________________________ Sümeyye (age).
b. Sümeyye is _________________________________ Sevilay (height).
c. Sevilay is ___________________________________ Sümeyye (weight).
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Answers:
a. Sevilay is younger than Sümeyye. (20 < 21)
b. Sümeyye is taller than Sevilay. (1.58 m > 1.45 m)
c. Sevilay is slimmer than Sümeyye. (or: lighter than / thinner than Sümeyye - 34 kg < 49 kg)

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: 'younger than' doğru yazılmış
b şıkkı: 'taller than' doğru yazılmış
c şıkkı: 'slimmer than' / 'lighter than' doğru yazılmış

openEndedQuestions.question: Write 2 English sentences describing your best friend: one about physical appearance and one about personality.
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
1. Physical Appearance: He is tall and slim with curly black hair.
2. Personality: She is very generous and honest because she always tells the truth and shares her books.

rubric.criterion: One grammatically correct physical appearance sentence
One grammatically correct personality adjective sentence

openEndedQuestions.question: Compare a plane and a bus using the adjective 'FAST', and compare a book and a comic using 'EXPENSIVE'. (Write 2 comparative sentences).
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
1. A plane is faster than a bus.
2. A book is more expensive than a comic.

rubric.criterion: Correct use of short adjective comparative (-er than)
Correct use of long adjective comparative (more ... than)

boss.name: Titanium Coach 'Mr. Champion'
boss.introText: If you don't know sports equipment or frequency adverbs, you can't join the champions league!
boss.defeatText: Incredible! From bossaball to adverbs of frequency, you mastered every sports rule! You win the gold medal!

lessons.title: 🏅 Types of Sports & Essential Equipment
lessons.summary: Bireysel ve takım sporları, açık/kapalı alan sporları ve spor malzemeleri.
points: Individual Sports (Bireysel Sporlar): Tek başına yapılan sporlar: cycling (bisiklet), archery (okçuluk), swimming (yüzme), skateboarding.
Team Sports (Takım Sporları): İki veya daha fazla takımla yapılan sporlar: football, basketball, volleyball, baseball, bossaball.

Sports Equipment (Spor Ekipmanları):
• Tennis: a racket, a ball, a net, trainers.
• Baseball: a small ball, a bat, gloves, comfortable clothes.
• Cycling: a bicycle and a helmet.
• Bossaball: Voleybol, futbol ve jimnastiği birleştiren, trambolin (trampoline) ve file (net) üzerinde topla oynanan eğlenceli bir takım sporudur. Oyuncular topa el, ayak veya başla vurabilir.
Indoor vs Outdoor: Kapalı salonda yapılan sporlara indoor, açık havada yapılan sporlara outdoor denir.
lessons.examTip: Sınav İpucu: 'Racket ve net' tenisi, 'bat ve gloves' beyzbolu, 'bicycle ve helmet' bisiklet sporunu gösterir!

quickCheck.q: You need a racket, a ball, trainers and a net to play this sport. Which sport is it?
quickCheck.explanation: Raket, file, ayakkabı ve topla oynanan spor tenistir.

pointAnalogies.title: Tek Kişilik Sahne (Individual Sports)
pointAnalogies.text: Kendi başına yarıştığın yüzme, okçuluk ve bisiklet Individual (bireysel) sporlardır.

pointAnalogies.title: Paslaşan Ekip (Team Sports)
pointAnalogies.text: Takım arkadaşlarıyla birlikte oynanan futbol, basketbol, voleybol ve bossaball Team Sports'tur.

pointAnalogies.title: Her Sporun Kendi Çantası (Equipment)
pointAnalogies.text: Teniste racket/net, bisiklette helmet, Bossaball'da ise trambolin + file + top (voleybol + futbol + jimnastik birleşimi) bulunur.

pointAnalogies.title: Çatı Altı (Indoor) vs. Açık Gökyüzü (Outdoor)
pointAnalogies.text: İçeride (IN-door) spor salonunda oynananlar indoor, dışarıda (OUT-door) açık havada oynananlar outdoor sporlardır.

lessons.title: ⏱️ Adverbs of Frequency & Daily Routines
lessons.summary: Eylemlerin yapılma sıklığını anlatan sıklık zarfları ve kullanım kuralları.
points:
Sıklık Zarfları ve Anlamları (Frequency Adverbs):
• Always (%100): Her zaman / Daima ('every day' ➔ always).
• Usually (%80): Genellikle.
• Often (%60): Sık sık.
• Sometimes (%40): Bazen / Ara sıra.
• Rarely / Seldom (%20): Nadiren ('once a month' ➔ rarely).
• Never (%0): Asla / Hiçbir zaman ('doesn't wake up late' ➔ never wakes up late).

Cümledeki Yeri: Sıklık zarfları ana fiilden ÖNCE gelir: Subject + Adverb + Verb.
• 'Yağız Kaan always trains hard for chess.'
• 'Şahika rarely has fast food.'
• 'Mete never gets up late on weekdays.'
'To Be' (am/is/are) İstisnası: 'am/is/are' fiillerinden SONRA gelir: Tom is always on time.
lessons.examTip: Sınavda Kesin Çıkar: 'Never' cümleye zaten 'asla/hiç' olumsuzluğu katar, bu yüzden fiil olumlu çekimlenir: 'He never gets up late' denir!

quickCheck.q: Yağız Kaan trains for chess every day, 7 days a week. Which frequency adverb should we use?
quickCheck.explanation: Her gün yapılan eylemler için 'always' (%100) kullanılır.

pointAnalogies.title: Pil Yüzdesi Gibi Sıklık Zarfları
pointAnalogies.text: Always %100 dolu pil, Usually %80, Often %60, Sometimes %40, Rarely %20, Never ise %0 boş pil demektir!

pointAnalogies.title: Ana Fiilin Hemen Önündeki Öncü
pointAnalogies.text: Normal fiillerde sıklık zarfı fiilden ÖNCE gelir: 'Mete NEVER gets up late'.

pointAnalogies.title: am / is / are Önden Geçer!
pointAnalogies.text: am/is/are VIP fiildir; sıklık zarfı onların arkasına geçer: 'Tom IS always on time'.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Tennis requires a racket, a net, and a ball.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Tenis için raket, file ve top gerekir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Baseball is an individual sport.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Beyzbol takım sporudur (team sport).

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Bossaball is played on a trampoline with a net and ball.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Bossaball trambolin üzerinde oynanır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Cycling requires a bicycle and a helmet.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Bisiklet sporu için kask ve bisiklet gerekir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Never' means doing something 100% of the time.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Never 'asla/hiç' (%0) demektir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Archery' is an individual sport played with a bow and arrows.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Okçuluk yay ve ok ile yapılan bireysel spordur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Football, basketball, and volleyball are team sports.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Birden fazla oyuncunun birlikte oynadığı takım sporlarıdır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Always' frequency adverb expresses 100% regularity (daima).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Always en yüksek sıklıktaki sıklı zarfıdır (%100).

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Goggles and a swimsuit are essential equipment for swimming.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Yüzme gözlüğü ve mayo yüzmenin temel ekipmanıdır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: In boxing, athletes wear special boxing gloves and punch a punching bag.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Boks sporu eldivenle yapılır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Spectator' is a person who plays the sport on the court.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Spectator sporcu değil, maçı izleyen seyircidir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'How often' question asks about the frequency of an activity.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! 'Ne sıklıkla' sorusudur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Skiing is an outdoor water sport.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Kayak kış ve kar sporudur, su sporu değildir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Train' or 'practice' means doing exercise to improve sports skills.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Antrenman yapmak anlamına gelir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Roller skating requires roller skates, knee pads, and a helmet.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Paten, dizlik ve kask güvenli paten için şarttır.

flashcards.q: Tennis için gereken temel malzemeler nelerdir?
'Once a month' hangi sıklık zarfına karşılık gelir?

flashcards.a: Trambolin üzerinde voleybol, futbol ve jimnastiği birleştiren takım sporu.

quizQuestions.q: You need a small ball, a bat, gloves, and comfortable clothes. Which sport is it?
quizQuestions.explanation: Sopa (bat), eldiven ve küçük topla oynanan spor beyzboldur.

quizQuestions.q: Mete Gazoz wakes up early every morning and doesn't wake up late. He _________ gets up late.

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.2.R1. Students will be able to understand short and simple texts on sports.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Read the text below and answer the questions:

"Bossaball brings together volleyball, soccer, and gymnastics. Two teams play against each other in this game. They play the game on a trampoline. Players jump high and hit the ball over the net. They can hit the ball with any body part, such as the head, hands, and feet. Each team works together and tries to beat the other team."

a. Is bossaball an individual sport?
b. Which equipment do you need for bossaball?
c. What is the aim of bossaball?
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Answers:
a. No, it isn't. (It is a team sport; two teams play against each other).
b. You need a trampoline, a ball, and a net.
c. The aim is to hit the ball over the net and beat the other team (score points).

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: 'No, it isn't / It is a team sport' doğru cevaplanmış
b şıkkı: Ekipmanlar (trampoline, ball, net) doğru yazılmış
c şıkkı: Oyunun amacı (hit the ball over the net / beat the other team) doğru açıklanmış

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.2.R1. Students will be able to understand short and simple texts on sports.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Adam and Defne are playing the 'Guess what it is' game. Read the cards and answer the questions below:

• Card A:
  "You need a racket, a pair of trainers, a ball, and a net. Two people play it."
  Adam: Volleyball | Defne: Tennis

• Card B:
  "You need a small ball, a bat, gloves, and comfortable clothes. It is a team sport."
  Adam: Basketball | Defne: Football

• Card C:
  "You need a bicycle and a helmet. You can do this sport individually."
  Adam: Motorcycling | Defne: Cycling

Questions:
a. Whose answer is correct for Card A?
b. For which card do both Defne and Adam write an incorrect answer? Write down the correct sport.
c. Who answers more questions correctly?
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Answers:
a. Defne's answer is correct for Card A (It is Tennis).
b. Both Defne and Adam write an incorrect answer for Card B. The correct sport is Baseball (or Cricket / Softball).
c. Defne answers more questions correctly (Defne answered 2 cards correctly: Card A - Tennis and Card C - Cycling).

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: Card A için Defne'nin doğru bildiği yazılmış
b şıkkı: Card B'nin yanlış bilindiği ve doğrusunun Baseball olduğu yazılmış
c şıkkı: Defne'nin daha çok soruya doğru yanıt verdiği yazılmış

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.2.W1. Students will be able to write pieces about routines/daily activities by using frequency adverbs.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Rewrite the sentences using a different frequency adverb for each sentence:
Options: [rarely, always, never]

a. Yağız Kaan Erdoğmuş trains hard for chess every day.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
b. Şahika Ercümen generally prefers healthy food, but she has fast food once a month.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
c. Mete Gazoz doesn’t get up late on weekdays. He wakes up at 7 am every morning.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Answers:
a. Yağız Kaan Erdoğmuş always trains hard for chess. ('every day' ➔ always)
b. Şahika Ercümen rarely has fast food. (or: She rarely eats fast food - 'once a month' ➔ rarely)
c. Mete Gazoz never gets up late on weekdays. ('doesn't get up late' ➔ never)

rubric.criterion: a şıkkı: 'always trains hard' şeklinde doğru yazılmış
b şıkkı: 'rarely has fast food' şeklinde doğru yazılmış
c şıkkı: 'never gets up late' şeklinde doğru yazılmış

openEndedQuestions.kazanim: E7.2.W1. Students will be able to write pieces about routines/daily activities by using frequency adverbs.
openEndedQuestions.question:
Look at the visual of Emma's daily routine and the star ratings for frequency adverbs:
★★★★★ = Always | ★★★★☆ = Usually | ★★★☆☆ = Often | ★★☆☆☆ = Sometimes | ★☆☆☆☆ = Rarely | ☆☆☆☆☆ = Never

Emma's Activities and Stars:
• Breakfast in the kitchen: ★☆☆☆☆
• Making her bed: ☆☆☆☆☆
• Working out / gym: ★★★★☆
• Reading books on the couch: ★★★★★
• Cycling in the park: ★★★☆☆
• Meeting friends at a café: ★★☆☆☆

Write down at least four (4) sentences about Emma’s daily routine using frequency adverbs.
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
Sample Sentences (Choose any 4):
1. Emma always reads books on the couch. (★★★★★)
2. Emma usually exercises / works out at the gym. (★★★★☆)
3. Emma often rides a bicycle / cycles in the park. (★★★☆☆)
4. Emma sometimes meets her friends at a café. (★★☆☆☆)
5. Emma rarely has breakfast. (★☆☆☆☆)
6. Emma never makes her bed. (☆☆☆☆☆)

boss.name: Chronos 'The Past Master'
boss.introText: Can you talk about past lives and milestones without mixing up was, were, and irregular verbs?
boss.defeatText: Incredible! You narrated history and biographies with flawless past tense!

lessons.title: ⏳ Simple Past Tense: Was / Were & Life Events
lessons.summary: Geçmişte yaşanan hayat olaylarını ve doğum/ölüm tarihlerini anlatma.
points:
Was / Were Kullanımı:
• I, He, She, It ➔ was (He was born in 1881).
• You, We, They ➔ were (They were at school yesterday).

Life Milestones (Hayat Dönüm Noktaları):
• was born (doğdu)
• grew up (büyüdü)
• graduated from university (üniversiteden mezun oldu)
• got married (evlendi)
• won an award / Nobel Prize (ödül kazandı)
• died (vefat etti).
Zaman Edatları: Yıllar ve aylardan önce in (in 1923, in May); tam günlerden önce on (on 19th May 1919) kullanılır.
lessons.examTip: Sınavda Sorulur: 'He was born IN 1881' (Yıllardan önce 'in' edatı kullanılır).

quickCheck.q: 'Mustafa Kemal Atatürk _________ born in Salonika in 1881.' cümlesindeki boşluğa ne gelmelidir?
quickCheck.explanation: Tekil özne (Atatürk / He) ile geçmiş zamanda 'was' kullanılır.

pointAnalogies.title: Tekil 'was', Çoğul 'were' (Geçmişin İki Anahtarı)
pointAnalogies.text: I/He/She/It tek kişi olduğu için kısa olan 'was' alır; You/We/They çoğul olduğu için uzun olan 'were' alır.

pointAnalogies.title: Bir Hayatın Fotoğraf Albümü (Milestones)
pointAnalogies.text: Doğdu (was born) → büyüdü (grew up) → mezun oldu (graduated) → evlendi (got married) → ödül kazandı (won an award).

pointAnalogies.title: Geniş Zaman 'in', Nokta Atışı Gün 'on'
pointAnalogies.text: Yıllar ve aylar geniş kutudur → IN (in 1923, in May). Tek bir takvim günü ise nokta atışıdır → ON (on 19th May).

lessons.title: ✍️ Regular & Irregular Verbs (Düzenli ve Düzensiz Fiiller)
lessons.summary: Geçmiş zamanda olumlu cümle kurarken fiillerin 2. hali (V2) kullanılır.
points:
Regular Verbs (Düzenli Fiiller): Sonuna -ed alır:
invent ➔ invented, discover ➔ discovered, die ➔ died, live ➔ lived.

Irregular Verbs (Düzensiz Fiiller): Kökten değişir, ezberlenmesi gerekir:
• go ➔ went
• write ➔ wrote
• win ➔ won
• have ➔ had
• become ➔ became.
lessons.examTip: Sınav Sorusu: Aziz Sancar won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015. ('Win' fiili 'won' olur!).

quickCheck.q: 'Marie Curie _________ two Nobel Prizes.' cümlesinde 'win' fiilinin past hali hangisidir?

pointAnalogies.title: Uslu Fiillere '-ed' Etiketi (Regular)
pointAnalogies.text: Düzenli fiiller kurala uyar, sonuna sadece '-ed' ekler: invent → invented, live → lived.

pointAnalogies.title: Kılık Değiştiren Fiiller (Irregular)
pointAnalogies.text: Düzensiz fiiller tırtılın kelebeğe dönüşmesi gibi tamamen değişir: go → went, write → wrote, win → won.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: We use 'was' with He, She, It and I in past tense.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Tekil öznelerde was kullanılır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The past form of 'go' is 'goed'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! 'Go' düzensiz fiildir, geçmiş hali 'went' olur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: We use 'in' before years (e.g., in 1923).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Yıllardan önce 'in' edatı gelir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Graduate' means to finish school or university.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Mezun olmak demektir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The past form of 'invent' is 'invented'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Düzenli fiil olduğu için -ed alır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The past form of 'buy' is 'bought'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Buy düzensiz bir fiildir (buy -> bought).

trueFalseQuestions.statement: We use 'were' with You, We, and They in Simple Past Tense.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Çoğul öznelerde were kullanılır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Win an award' means to receive a prize or medal for an achievement.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Ödül kazanmak anlamına gelir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: The past form of 'write' is 'writed'.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Write düzensizdir, geçmiş hali 'wrote' olur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: 'Grow up' means to spend childhood and become an adult.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Büyümek, yetişmek demektir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Aziz Sancar won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! 2015 yılında Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Regular verbs in English take '-ed' in the past form (e.g., play -> played).
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Düzenli fiillere -ed takısı gelir.

flashcards.q: Atatürk ne zaman ve nerede doğdu?
flashcards.a: He was born in 1881 in Salonika.
Discover = Zaten var olanı keşfetmek, Invent = Yeni bir alet icat etmek

quizQuestions.q: Alexander Graham Bell _________ the telephone in 1876.
quizQuestions.explanation: Geçmişte tamamlanmış bir eylem için düzenli fiile -ed eklenir: invented.

quizQuestions.q: Prof. Aziz Sancar _________ the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015.

quizQuestions.explanation: 'You' öznesi ile geçmiş zamanda 'were' kullanılır: Where were you born?

openEndedQuestions.question: Write 2 biographical sentences in past tense about a famous scientist or leader (mention birth year and an achievement).
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
1. Thomas Edison was born in 1847.
2. He invented the electric light bulb in 1879.

rubric.criterion: Correct past tense birth sentence with 'was born in'
Correct past tense achievement sentence with regular/irregular V2 verb

boss.name: Poacher Shadow 'Kafesçi'
boss.introText: I hunt wild animals for their fur and tusks! You can't stop me without wildlife rules!
boss.defeatText: Brilliant! You protected endangered habitats and stopped animal extinction!

lessons.title: 🐾 Animal Habitats, Diets & Extinction
lessons.summary: Vahşi hayvan türleri, beslenme şekilleri ve nesli tükenen canlılar.
points:
Diets (Beslenme Türleri):
• Carnivore: Etobur (lion, tiger, eagle).
• Herbivore: Otobur (elephant, giraffe, deer).
• Omnivore: Hem otçul hem etçil (bear, monkey).

Extinct vs Endangered:
• Extinct: Nesli tamamen tükenmiş canlılar (Dinosaurs, Mammoths, Dodo bird).
• Endangered: Nesli tükenme tehlikesi altında olanlar (Pandas, Polar bears, Bengal tigers).
Animal Body Parts: tusk (fildişi), fur (kürk), claw (pençe), wing (kanat), tail (kuyruk).

quickCheck.q: Mammoths and Dodo birds no longer exist today. They are ___________ animals.

pointAnalogies.title: Doğanın 3 Menü Seçeneği
pointAnalogies.text: Carnivore et menüsü (aslan), Herbivore salata menüsü (zürafa), Omnivore ise karışık menü (ayı, maymun) yer!

pointAnalogies.title: Artık Yok (Extinct) vs. Tehlikede (Endangered)
pointAnalogies.text: Dinozorlar tamamen yok oldu (Extinct). Pandalar ve kutup ayıları hâlâ yaşıyor ama korumazsak yok olacaklar (Endangered).

pointAnalogies.title: Hayvanların Süper Ekipmanları
pointAnalogies.text: Filin dişi 'tusk', ayının sıcak ceketi 'fur', kartalın kanadı 'wing', aslanın pençesi 'claw'dır.

lessons.title: 🛡️ Giving Advice to Protect Wildlife: Should / Shouldn't
lessons.summary: Doğayı ve vahşi yaşamı korumak için öneri cümleleri.
points:
We SHOULD (Yapmalıyız):
• We should protect natural habitats (doğal yaşam alanlarını korumalıyız).
• We should plant more trees.
• We should stop illegal hunting.

We SHOULDN'T (Yapmamalıyız):
• We shouldn't hunt animals for their fur and tusks (kürk ve fildişi için avlamamalıyız).
• We shouldn't pollute rivers and oceans.
• We shouldn't destroy forests.
lessons.examTip: Sınav Sorusu: 'We shouldn't hunt animals for their fur' (Hayvanları kürkü için avlamamalıyız).

quickCheck.q: We _________ destroy rainforests because animals lose their habitats.

pointAnalogies.title: Doğanın Dostu Ol (SHOULD)
pointAnalogies.text: Should 'yapmalıyız' demektir: Ağaç dikmeli (plant trees), yaşam alanlarını korumalıyız (protect habitats).

pointAnalogies.title: Doğaya Zarar Verme (SHOULDN'T)
pointAnalogies.text: Shouldn't 'yapmamalıyız' demektir: Kürk/fildişi için avlamamalı (shouldn't hunt), ormanları yok etmemeliyiz.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Dinosaurs are extinct animals.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Nesilleri tamamen tükenmiştir.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Herbivores eat meat.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Herbivore otobur demektir, bitki yer. Etobur olan carnivore'dur.

trueFalseQuestions.statement: We should hunt endangered animals for their tusks.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Yanlış! Asla avlamamalıyız (We shouldn't hunt).

trueFalseQuestions.statement: Pandas are endangered species.
trueFalseQuestions.explanation: Doğru! Pandaların nesli tükenme tehlikesindedir.

flashcards.a: Extinct = Nesli tükenmiş, Endangered = Tükenme tehlikesi olan

flashcards.q: Doğal yaşamı korumak için ne yapmalıyız?
flashcards.a: We should protect natural habitats and stop illegal hunting.

quizQuestions.q: Lions and tigers eat only meat. They are _________.
quizQuestions.explanation: Sadece et yiyen hayvanlar 'carnivore' (etobur) olarak adlandırılır.

quizQuestions.q: We _________ cut down trees and destroy natural habitats.
quizQuestions.explanation: Doğal yaşam alanlarını yok etmemeliyiz: shouldn't.

openEndedQuestions.question: Write 2 sentences giving advice on how to protect wild animals (use 'should' and 'shouldn't').
openEndedQuestions.sampleAnswer:
1. We should protect natural habitats and forests.
2. We shouldn't hunt endangered animals for their fur and tusks.

rubric.criterion: One correct advice sentence using 'should'
One correct warning sentence using 'shouldn't'
